source: Codex: Adeptus Custodes (January 2022), Talons of the Emperor: ADEPTUS CUSTODES detachments may include ANATHEMA PSYKANA units (research library 03_Codexes/Imperium/Adeptus_Custodes.md §3 Detachment abilities).
